entities.summary: Thaddeus Cho Hwan-kil (b. 1954-11-07, Dalseong County) was a entrepreneur or business leader of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Dalseong County and South Korea. Known in the fields of south korea, religious figures, asia.
